title: Jacobi symbol modulo an odd integer
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $n$ with $n$ odd, applying the modular Jacobi algorithm to the pairing of their binary expansions yields the binary expansion of the least nonnegative residue of the Jacobi symbol $(a/n)$ modulo $n$.
